candidate.definition_en: Clever, original, and inventive in finding new ways to do things or solve problems.
candidate.explanation_ar: شخص ذكي ومبتكر جداً، أو فكرة/اختراع يتسم بالعبقرية والابتكار.

senses.definition_en: (of a person) very clever, skillful, and inventive
examples: She is an ingenious cook who creates new recipes.

senses.definition_en: (of an object, plan, or idea) cleverly designed, original, and inventive
senses.definition_ar: (للخطة أو الاختراع أو الفكرة) متقن، عبقري، ومبتكر
examples: The engineer came up with an ingenious solution to the problem.
The device is simple but ingenious.
The engineer came up with an ingenious solution to the problem.
The device is simple but ingenious.
She is an ingenious cook who creates new recipes.
candidate.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Genius' 'عبقري'.. الـ 'Ingenious' هو الشخص العبقري أو الفكرة العبقرية.
